question: Which force will get the Ashwini radar system under the ₹2,906-crore deal signed in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Air Force**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Ashwini radar system** is a state-of-the-art 4D radar system designed for advanced air surveillance and tracking.
 
• In **March 2025**, under a ₹2,906-crore deal, the **Indian Air Force** is set to procure this radar system to enhance its operational capabilities.
 
• The Ashwini radar system is equipped with **active electronically scanned array (AESA)** technology, offering superior range, resolution, and reliability for aerial threat detection and tracking.
 
• The primary purpose of these radars is to bolster the **air defense capabilities of the Indian Air Force** by detecting and tracking incoming enemy aircraft, drones, and missiles.
 
• The procurement of the Ashwini radar system aligns with India's **Make in India initiative**, as the system is indigenously developed by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (**DRDO**).&
